description: This file provides debugging utilities for tracking goroutine execution in the Go HTTP/2 package, including goroutine ID extraction and runtime checks.

methods.name: newGoroutineLock
methods.description: Creates a new goroutine lock object that tracks the current goroutine ID if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the current goroutine matches the stored goroutine ID, panics if not.

methods.name: checkNotOn
methods.description: Checks if the current goroutine does not match the stored goroutine ID, panics if it does.

methods.name: curGoroutineID
methods.description: Retrieves the current goroutine's ID by parsing runtime stack information.

methods.name: parseUintBytes
methods.description: Parses a uint64 from a byte slice with specified base and bit size.
